name: Vorton [Early Alpha]
desc:
[EARLY BETA. REPORT ANY BUGS OR PROVIDE FEEDBACK IN OUR COMMUNITY FORUM.]

VORTON is a fan-made recreation of old ROBLOX. There is no specific target time period, and everything is entirely custom.

📊 In-Depth Economy: Participate in a player-run economy by purchasing, selling, and trading limited items.
🔨 VORTON Studio: Use our recreation of ROBLOX Studio to create, publish, and share your own games.
👤 User Profiles: Personalize your VORTON profile with a unique username and an avatar that suits you.
🎉 Events: Participate in frequent limited-time events to obtain special items.
🏆 Achievements: Collect many, many different badges by completing in-game tasks.

This is an independent project founded in April 2025, worked on entirely by two individuals with a few minor contributors. We strongly appreciate all the support this project has received and will continue to improve VORTON in the coming years.
